info.name: DATH Enrollment API acceptance tests (Issue #8)
info.description: Runs enroll, list, progress, resume, leave and authorization checks. Configure baseUrl, studentEmail/studentPassword, publishedCourseId and lessonId from test fixtures.

exec: pm.test('enrollment list requires authentication', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); });

pm.test('my enrollments include the selected course', function () { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(body.data.some((entry) => entry.course_id === pm.environment.get('publishedCourseId'))).to.eql(true); });

item.name: List my courses grouped by status

exec: pm.test('my courses response separates active and completed courses', function () { const data = pm.response.json().data; pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(data.inProgress).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(data.completed).to.be.an('array'); });

pm.test('progress is saved and enrollment summary is returned', function () { const data = pm.response.json().data; pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(data.is_completed).to.eql(true); pm.expect(data.enrollment.last_lesson_id).to.eql(pm.environment.get('lessonId')); pm.expect(data.enrollment.progress_percent).to.be.a('number'); });
pm.test('negative playback position is rejected', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(400); });

pm.test('resume response points to the last lesson', function () { const data = pm.response.json().data; pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(data.courseId).to.eql(pm.environment.get('publishedCourseId')); pm.expect(data.lastLessonId).to.eql(pm.environment.get('lessonId')); });
pm.test('student can leave course', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.status).to.eql('left'); });

item.name: Progress update is blocked after leaving

exec: pm.test('non-enrolled student cannot update progress', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(403); });
